description: This is a Java test source file for integration testing of loan summary and related functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It contains multiple test cases that verify behaviors such as interest calculations, payables, and principal modifications for loans.

classes.name: LoanSummaryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests various aspects of loan summaries, interest calculations, and principal modifications within the Fineract loan processing system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Static method annotated with @BeforeAll to snapshot the current configuration for 'LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS'.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Static method annotated with @AfterAll to restore original configuration after tests.

methods.name: testUnpaidPayableNotDueInterestForProgressiveLoanInCaseOfEarlyRepayment
methods.description: Test case verifying unpaid payable not-due interest calculations during early repayment scenarios of progressive loans.

methods.name: testUnpaidPayableNotDueInterestForProgressiveLoanInCaseOfEarlyRepaymentAlmostFullyPaid2ndPeriod
methods.description: Test case focusing on interest calculations for a nearly fully paid second period in a progressive loan, ensuring proper interest and payable states.

methods.name: testCapitalizedIncomeExistsInRepaymentScheduleAndModifiesPrincipal
methods.description: Test verifying that capitalized income updates principal and repayment schedule appropriately.
